data.name: Frederique
data.gender_notes: Frederique is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic 'Frederic', meaning 'peaceful ruler'. Popularized in France where it became synonymous with 'the peaceable one'. The name Frederique carries the meaning “Peaceful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Frederique usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Frederique belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Frederique total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
